level_reasons: Break My Fix finding 1: an input that breaks unyt.array.unyt_array.to_astropy

issue.title: unyt fails to convert dimensionless array to astropy using .to_astropy()

summary.text: The original bug was reproduced, but Break My Fix found an input the fixed `to_astropy` mishandles. `unyt_array([1, 2, 3], 'km/m')` returns a dimensionless `Quantity [1., 2., 3.]`, which appears to drop the km/m scale factor of 1000; check how the fix handles dimensionless units that are not pure numbers.

survivors.description: Multiplies the unyt array itself rather than its value, giving a wrong type.
